title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Ref: CH017 Vacancy: Customer Service Advisor Location: Crawley, West Sussex Industry: Lighting & Electrical products Salary: up to circa £36,000 per annum, negotiable depending on experience Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 5.30pm, 1 in 3 Saturday mornings 9am to 12.30pm Do you have experience in the electrical wholesale industry? Tired of sales? Want a customer service role instead? This may be just the role for you We are recruiting for a customer service advisor for our client in the Crawley area of West Sussex. As a Customer Advisor you will: - Exceed customers expectations and keep customer service standards maintained - Handle inbound telephone calls and e-mails from customers - Support all aspects of the customer journey from product queries, advice and aftersales care - Take ownership of any general issues, finding suitable solutions for customers - Providing prompt, efficient and consistent information and communication in line with company policy - Liaise with other departments to ensure best service is maintained - Build a strong relationship with the team and customers. The ideal candidate will have - Great spoken and written communication skills - The ability to build a rapport with people quickly and effectively - A professional and pro-active attitude with exceptional attention to detail. - Excellent organisational skills and a passion for providing outstanding customer service - The ability to problem solve quickly and take ownership comfortably - Confident, resilient and assertive decision-making skills - Great MS Office skills - Customer Service experience - Experience in an electrical wholesale business is essential This is a great opportunity to join a growing business with plans for future expansion. If you feel that you have the right skills for this opportunity, please send us your CV. All applications are dealt with in the strictest of confidence. Rhodium Consulting Ltd is a niche recruitment consultancy specialising in wholesalers, merchants and distributors within the building products sector. We strive to be the industry leader in delivering the highest calibre of candidates to our client companies, whilst enhancing the careers of our candidates. For further information and contact details, please visit our website.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: We are very pleased to be working alongside our established, expanding, friendly and highly reputable client as they seek to recruit into their team within their modern offices in East Grinstead. Customer Service Advisor x 2 positions East Grinstead with free parking available for all staff on site. Due to office location it is essential to be a driver and have your own transport Full time permanent role - Monday - Friday (Apply online only) or (Apply online only). Office based role until successful completion of probationary period, you can then work 50/50 office / home based once probationary has been passed successfully. Salary £27500-£29300 plus very good all round company benefits, including good pension scheme, 22 days holidays plus all UK bank holidays (rising to 25 days holiday plus all UK bank holidays). Life assurance, regular social events and discretionary company bonus scheme This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in customer service, account coordination, logistics, fulfilment, supply chain, client services, or operations administration who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment. Working as part of the operations team, you'll act as the key point of contact for a portfolio of clients, ensuring exceptional service delivery while coordinating with internal departments to keep orders moving efficiently. As well as working as part of a forward thinking and reputable business, this opportunity offers the following: - Permanent career opportunity with a growing and successful organisation - Supportive and collaborative team environment - Training and development opportunities - Varied and engaging role with client interaction - Opportunity to contribute to process improvements and business growth - Clear progression potential within a leading business The role - Customer Service Advisor You will be responsible for managing client relationships, coordinating operational activities, and ensuring customer requirements are met in line with agreed service levels. Duties and responsibilities include: - Act as the primary point of contact for client enquiries via phone and email - Build strong relationships with customers, providing regular updates and reports - Manage client accounts and ensure orders are processed accurately and efficiently - Resolve operational issues and customer queries promptly - Liaise with warehouse teams, carriers, and internal departments to ensure seamless service delivery - Monitor service levels and ensure adherence to agreed service level agreements - Track and update customer requests using CRM and ticketing systems - Participate in customer calls and follow up on actions as required - Manage bookings, carriage arrangements, and associated billing activities - Escalate and resolve cany complaints professionally and effectively - Monitor operational performance and report on key metrics and KPI's - Identify opportunities to improve processes and enhance the customer experience - Support wider account management activities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives Experience, skills and competencies required: We're looking for someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about delivering excellent customer service. Skills & Experience - Previous experience within a customer service, account management, or operational support environment - Strong communication and relationship-building skills - Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks - Confident using CRM, ticketing, and business management systems - Strong problem-solving abilities and a solutions-focused approach - Ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment - Excellent attention to detail and accuracy For more information regarding this new and exciting Customer Service Advisor opportunity, please apply now! Short-listing will take place soon - don't miss out! Berry Recruitment Services Ltd T/A First Recruitment Services is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy. title: Part time customer service administrator
description: Part-Time Customer Service Administrator Location: Outskirts of Horsham must drive Hours: Monday to Friday, approx. 9:30am 2:30pm flexibility available Salary: £30,000 FTE / approx. £21,430 per annum based on 25 hours per week Holiday: 22 days + Bank Holidays (pro rata) Are you an experienced Customer Service Administrator looking for a part-time opportunity offering excellent work-life balance and some flexibility around your working hours? We are recruiting for a fantastic company based on the outskirts of Horsham who are looking for a confident, organised and customer-focused individual to join their busy team. This is a busy and varied role with plenty of customer interaction. A large part of your day will involve speaking with customers over the telephone, so you'll need to have a confident, friendly and professional telephone manner and genuinely enjoy dealing with people. You'll also be responsible for processing and managing customer orders through the company's CRM system, so being comfortable using technology and learning new systems is essential. The role will include: - Handling incoming and outgoing customer calls - Responding to customer enquiries - Processing and managing customer orders - Updating customer and order information on the CRM system - Following orders through and resolving any queries - Liaising with customers and internal departments - General administration and data entry - Managing a busy and varied workload We're looking for someone who: - Has previous customer service and/or administration experience - Is confident and professional on the telephone - Has strong IT skills and is comfortable using CRM/database systems - Is organised with excellent attention to detail - Can manage multiple tasks and priorities - Has a positive and proactive approach - Must drive and have access to their own transport due to the location The company can offer some flexibility around the working hours, with approximately 9:30am 2:30pm Monday to Friday being one option. This is a great opportunity to join an excellent, established company with a supportive working environment, competitive salary and attractive part-time hours. HL123

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Customer Support Role Technical Troubleshooting We re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers, solving problems and learning technical products inside-out. This is not a scripted call-centre role. You will be part of a small, friendly team, supporting customers with our fire safety products and systems. You ll help installers, engineers and end users diagnose issues, resolve faults over the phone and deliver an outstanding customer experience every time. You will be commercially aware and able to spot opportunities to sell through the natural flow of conversations with customers. You will have a number of years experience in a customer service environment and be a great team player. You must be comfortable speaking to customers on the phone and responding to emails. Learning and understanding our products is key to success in this role, so you should be technically curious and willing to develop your product knowledge to ensure you provide the best possible support. A willingness to learn and take a flexible approach is essential. Experience in a customer support role involving hardware and systems will be a great advantage, as will sales support experience. The full job description will be sent to you when you apply.
